adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms used for balance and holding the rope.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular descent around a vertical pole.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso remains suspended by a rope at the waist.
movement_profile.partnering: Coordinated movement between the four descending dancers.
movement_profile.posture: Upright on the platform; inverted during descent.

signature_moves.description: Falling backward from the frame to spin toward the ground.
signature_moves.name: The Descent

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not attempt without professional training and traditional authorization.

music_profile.sound_description: The music consists of a high-pitched, melodic flute accompanied by the rhythmic beat of a small drum, played from the top of a 30-meter pole.

basic_steps: Climb the pole to the platform
Wind the rope around the waist
teaching.formation: Five participants: one at the center top, four on a square frame.
teaching.level_notes: Advanced: Requires significant physical training, balance, and adherence to traditional taboos.
